messages:
maya: Heads-up — red-team engagement confirmed for Thu Apr 8. We need readroom slotting, ephemeral KMS access, and a single-owner RBAC plan. Who can own access handoff?
olga: I can own the readroom + access coord. Need exact assessor list and target scope by EOD tomorrow.
kevin: For KMS: we'll issue an ephemeral wrapping key via KMS Proxy. Need list of key ARNs and which services require decrypt.
tony: @olga thx. assessor list is coming from the vendor — will paste here when they confirm.
security-bot: Reminder: create evidence channel + set retention policy to 90d for the engagement artifacts.
olga: Proposed flow: 1) create readroom bucket with prefix redteam/2026-04-08 2) enable object-level logging 3) grant assessor role for timeboxed window.
maya: +1. Also need to toggle audit-level for model-serving paths (tokenization logs) during window. Ops, can we increase audit log retention temporarily?
devops-oncall: We can bump retention to 180d for that project, but it's a config change in log-archiver. I'll schedule a change window.
kevin: Ephemeral KMS plan sketch: create a key policy that allows kms:Decrypt only for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redteam-assessor. Use GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext and Encrypt/Decrypt in proxy. Sample policy snippet:```json
{
  "Effect":"Allow",
  "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redteam-assessor"},
  "Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext"],
  "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/REDACTED"
}```
olga: That's helpful. We need to confirm HSM-backed vs software key. Vendor asked for HSM-backed. Can security confirm procurement/path?
maya: We have an HSM key available in prod KMS, tag: hsm-redteam-2026. I'll coordinate with compliance for usage.
tony: Retest coordination: vendor wants tentative retest slot 2 weeks after initial run. We should block calendar: Apr 22 — reserve readroom and ephemeral role access.
kevin: Also, recommend enabling prefix KV caching disabled for the readroom sessions to avoid stale responses affecting proofing — config flag: `disable_kv_cache=true` per-route.
devops-oncall: I'll push a canary with disable_kv_cache on staging at 03:00 PST tomorrow and monitor latency. If OK, we schedule for Thu.
assessor-bot: Vendor (RedHawk) confirmed 3 assessors: alice.redhawk, bob.redhawk, charlie.redhawk. Email handshake done.
olga: Perfect. Action items: @kevin create ephemeral key policy and send ARN; @devops-oncall schedule retention bump and canary; @maya confirm HSM approval; @tony block retest slot. I'll assemble the evidence bucket and invite assessors.
maya: I'll do HSM approval by EOD and post the approval doc link: https://rwd.internal/docs/redteam/hsm-approval-2026-04-08
kevin: FYI — will need a short-lived IAM role with session duration 4h and MFA enforced. Proposed role name: redteam_assessor_session_role.
olga: Agree. Also add a small checklist in the readroom: list of endpoints, expected probes, no-exploit exceptions, contact oncall. I'll draft now and drop it here.
tony: Thanks all. If anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall and @devops-oncall. :thumbsup:
